Definition: properly, to plump, i.e. fill up hollows; by implication, to cover (for clothing or secrecy)
BiblicalUsage: Kacah is covering — to fill up the hollows and hide what lies beneath. The waters returned and covered Pharaoh's chariots; Shem and Japheth walked backward to cover their father's nakedness; and God Himself says to Jerusalem, I spread my skirt over thee and covered thee.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this is the word behind atonement itself: to cover is what God does with sin. He does not pretend it is not there — He covers it, and in Christ the covering is complete.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
